what.text: This page follows refugees from Mauritania living in Senegal, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 16650 Mauritanian refugees in Senegal, 37.9% of all refugees from Mauritania.
Senegal is the largest host of Mauritanian refugees, followed by Mali, France and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict in Mauritania in the main years of displacement, so it does not say why people left.
UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mauritania with AQIM in 2010 only.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1989 at 48236 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 67844, at the end of 1993 and 1994, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1989 to 1998.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Senegal.
These are year-end totals for Senegal only, reported to UNHCR.
